credits.lowBody: A test costs at least {min} credits. Review a video in your niche to earn one, or buy a pack.

auth.title: Clickable
auth.tagline: Test your thumbnail, title and first 60 seconds on real people in your niche before you publish.
auth.linkSent: Check your inbox. Open the link on this device to sign in.
auth.linkFailed: That sign-in link didn't work. It may have expired, or been opened on another device.

welcome.title: Know before you publish
welcome.lede: Clickable shows your thumbnail, title and first 60 seconds to real creators in your niche, then tells you what they actually thought.
welcome.step1Title: Upload what you're about to publish
welcome.step1Body: Up to three thumbnails, a few titles, and your first 60 seconds.
welcome.step2Title: Real people in your niche decide
welcome.step2Body: They pick one, guess what the video is about, and say where they'd stop watching.
welcome.step3Body: Which thumbnail won, which title landed, and the exact second attention drops.
welcome.creditsTitle: It runs on credits, not a subscription
welcome.creditsBody: Review a video, earn a credit. Spend credits to get your own video tested. You start with five.

onboarding.nicheHint: You'll review videos from this niche, and your tests go to people in it.
onboarding.languageTitle: Which language are your videos in?
onboarding.channelHint: YouTube, Instagram or TikTok. We only use it to show who you are — we never post, like or follow anything.
onboarding.channelInvalid: Paste a channel or profile link: youtube.com/@name, instagram.com/name or tiktok.com/@name. A link to a single post won't work.

submit.empty: No tests yet. Upload a thumbnail, a few titles and your first 60 seconds, and see what real people in your niche think.

wizard.thumbnailsHint: Each reviewer sees one of them in a feed, next to real videos from your niche. Images are resized to 1280×720 for you.
wizard.titlesHint: Reviewers see one title with the thumbnail, then tell you what they expect the video to be about.
wizard.clipHint: Pick the clip from your gallery. Longer videos are trimmed to 60 seconds while you choose, then compressed to 720p.
wizard.countHint: One review costs one credit. Unused credits come back when the test closes.
wizard.done: Your test is live. Reviews will arrive over the next 72 hours.
wizard.clipHintWeb: Your first 60 seconds, exported as MP4 or MOV at 720p and under 8 MB. The browser doesn't compress, so a longer or heavier file is rejected.
wizard.channelHint: Reviewers are matched to the channel's niche, so pick the one publishing this video.
wizard.formatHint: Reviewers see it the way people will: a tall clip among tall videos, a wide one among wide videos.

errors.insufficient_credits: Not enough credits for this test.
errors.onboarding_incomplete: Finish setting up your channel first.
errors.title_too_long: Titles can be up to 100 characters.
errors.clip_too_long: That clip is longer than 60 seconds. Trim it while picking.
errors.clip_too_short: That clip is shorter than 5 seconds.
errors.clip_too_large: Even after compression, this clip is over 8 MB. Try a shorter or simpler one.
errors.clip_wrong_type: That file type isn't supported. Export an MP4 or MOV.
errors.clip_too_long_web: That clip is longer than 60 seconds. Export just the first 60 seconds from your editor.
errors.clip_orientation: That clip isn't the shape you picked. Go back a step to change it, or choose another clip.

requirements.title: What to have ready
requirements.thumbnails: 1–3 thumbnails. Any size — they're resized to 1280×720 for you.
requirements.clipApp: Your video. Only the first 60 seconds are used; longer files are trimmed and compressed to 720p on your phone.
requirements.clipWeb: Your first 60 seconds as an MP4 or MOV, 8 MB or less — export it from your editor at 720p. The browser doesn't compress, so a longer or heavier file is rejected.

hidden.title: Paused after a report

reason.inappropriate: Someone reported this as inappropriate content.
reason.spam: Someone reported this as spam or misleading.
reason.copyright: Someone reported this as not your content.

hidden.body: Your unused credits are already back in your balance. If this was wrong, tell us and a person will look at it.
hidden.notePlaceholder: It's my own video, I filmed it
hidden.sent: Appeal sent. We'll look at it and write back.

errors.already_appealed: You've already appealed this one. We're looking at it.

submit.screeningNote: We check every thumbnail before reviewers see it. It only takes a moment.

paywall.title: Credits and Pro
paywall.earnInstead: Every review you give earns a credit. Buying is just a shortcut for when you'd rather not spend the time.
paywall.restored: Your Pro subscription is active again.
paywall.restoredNothing: Nothing to restore on this account.

options.creditsBody: A credit pays for one reviewer on one test, and credits never expire.
options.proBody: {count} credits every month, priority in the queue, up to 25 reviewers per test, and an AI summary of your results.

result.pending: Payment went through. The credits land as soon as the store confirms it, usually within a minute.
result.pro: Pro is active. This month's credits land in a moment.

unavailable.title: You'll need the app for this
unavailable.web_unsupported: Google Play and the App Store handle the payment, so buying only works inside the app. Everything else — reviewing, results, credits — works right here.
unavailable.not_configured: This build has no store keys, so buying is switched off. Reviewing still earns credits.

errors.load: The store didn't answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.store_error: The store couldn't complete that. Nothing was charged.
errors.not_configured: This build has no store keys, so buying is switched off.
errors.web_unsupported: Buying only works in the mobile app.

renewal.monthly: Renews every month at the price above until you cancel.
renewal.yearly: Renews every year at the price above until you cancel.
renewal.cancel: Cancel any time in your store account — the subscription runs to the end of the period you paid for.

ready.title: A test is waiting
ready.body: Takes about two minutes, and earns you a credit.
ready.step2: Say what you expect it to be about
ready.step3: Watch the opening, and stop where you'd stop

empty.title: Nothing to review right now
empty.body: Nobody in your niche is testing at the moment. Come back later, or turn on notifications and we'll tell you when a test arrives.
empty.enablePush: Tell me when a test arrives
empty.pushOn: We'll let you know when a test shows up in your niche.
empty.pushFailed: Notifications aren't working on this device yet. We're fixing it — nothing you did is wrong.
empty.limitBody: You've reviewed a lot today, and thank you. We cap it at 20 a day so every review stays worth reading. Come back tomorrow and your next one earns a credit again.

guess.question: What is this video about, in one sentence?

hook.video: The first seconds of the video
hook.loadFailed: The clip didn't load. Check your connection and tap to try again.

done.body: Thanks. Your review is on its way to the creator.

errors.review_too_fast: That was too quick to be a real review, so it wasn't counted and you didn't earn a credit. Take your time with the next one.
errors.task_expired: This task has expired. Grab a new one from the Review tab.
errors.submission_closed: This test has already collected enough reviews.
errors.invalid_watch: The playback times didn't add up. Try again.
errors.reviewer_blocked: Reviewing is paused on your account. This happens when reviews look automatic — the same spot picked every time, say, or the clip skipped instantly on every task. Reply to your sign-in email if you think this is wrong.
errors.niche_cache_empty: We're still collecting example videos for your niche. Try again later.

demo.title: Practice test
demo.body: Practice tests stay open, so there's always something to review, and they still earn you a credit. Answer exactly as you would for anyone else.

reveal.hitTitle: That was the one being tested
reveal.body: Your click is already recorded. Now watch the opening and tell us what you think.

scope.title: Also review
scope.body: Pick a few more niches or languages you're happy to review. Your own tests still go to your niche only, so results stay meaningful.

stats.title: You
stats.flagged: Reviewing is paused on your account. Reply to your sign-in email if you think this is wrong.

niche.canChange: You can change your niche once a month.
niche.locked: You can change it again in {days} {days:day|days}.

errors.niche_change_too_soon: You changed it recently. You can change your niche once a month.
errors.unknown_niche: Pick a niche from the list.

credits.title: Credit history
credits.empty: Nothing yet. Reviewing a video earns your first credit.
credits.buyHint: Reviewing other creators earns credits for free. Buying is for when you'd rather not spend the time.
credits.proBody: 40 credits every month, 25 reviews per test instead of 15, and an AI summary of your results.
credits.proActive: Pro is active on your account.

account.title: Account
account.deleteHint: Deleting removes your account, your tests and your credit history. The reviews you wrote on other people's tests stay, with your name removed, so their results still add up.
account.deleteConfirm: This can't be undone. Your account, your tests and your credits will be deleted.
account.contactHint: Questions, bugs, or a problem with a review: write to {email} and a person will read it.

channels.title: Your channels
channels.body: Each channel has its own niche. A test goes to the niche of the channel that publishes it.
channels.addHint: YouTube, Instagram or TikTok. Reviewers are matched to this channel's niche, so pick the one it publishes in.

errors.channel_limit: You can link up to five channels.
errors.channel_taken: That channel is already linked to another account.
errors.niche_change_too_soon: You changed this channel's niche recently. Try again next month.
errors.unknown_platform: We only accept YouTube, Instagram and TikTok links for now.

collab.title: Collabs
collab.body: Meet creators in your niche at a similar size. No credits, no tasks, nothing on YouTube — just an introduction.
collab.openHint: While this is off, nobody sees you and you see nobody.
collab.bioPlaceholder: What you make, and what you'd like to do together.

errors.no_type: Pick at least one kind of collab, or turn this off.
errors.save_failed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

language.title: Language
language.body: The language of this app. It does not change which videos you review.

results.title: Results
results.waiting: No reviews yet. They usually start arriving within a few hours.

thumbnails.title: Thumbnails
thumbnails.noWinner: Too close to call a winner yet.

aiSummary.title: AI summary
aiSummary.ready: Five blunt points from what your reviewers actually did, plus the one change worth making first.
aiSummary.quota: {used} of {limit} summaries used in the last 30 days.
aiSummary.proRequired: Pro turns your results into five points and names the one change to make first.
aiSummary.notEnoughReviews: It needs {need} reviews to be worth writing, and you have {have}. Three people aren't a pattern.
aiSummary.monthlyLimit: You've used all {limit} summaries for the last 30 days. The oldest one frees up as it ages out.

errors.summary_failed: The summary couldn't be written. Nothing was used up — try again.
errors.monthly_limit: You've used all your summaries for the last 30 days.
errors.in_progress: A summary is already being written for this test.
errors.ai_summary_unavailable: Summaries are switched off right now. Nothing was used up.

report.title: Report this
report.body: Tell us what's wrong. Reports are read by a person, and nothing is deleted automatically.

errors.no_access: You can only report something you've seen here.
errors.invalid_reason: Pick one of the reasons above.

collab.title: Collabs
collab.intro: Same niche, similar size. No credits involved, and nothing happens on YouTube.

history.both: Reviewed {they} of your tests; you reviewed {me} of theirs.

block.title: Block {name}?
block.body: You won't see each other again, and neither of you can send a message.

closed.title: Collabs are off
closed.body: Turn on "I'm open to collabs" in your profile and pick what you're up for. Nobody sees you until you do.

empty.title: That's everyone for now
empty.body: You've seen everyone in your niche at a similar size. New creators turn collabs on all the time, so check back in a few days.

error.title: Couldn't load creators
error.body: Check your connection and try again.
error.action: That didn't go through. Try again.

matches.title: Matches
matches.emptyBody: When someone you're interested in is interested back, they'll show up here.

chat.intro: You and {name} matched. No credits involved, and nothing happens on YouTube.
chat.empty: Nothing here yet. Tell {name} what you make and what you had in mind.
chat.goneBody: One of you blocked the other, so neither of you can write here.

report.title: Report this message?
report.body: We keep a copy of the message so a person can look at it. Blocking is separate — you can do both.

errors.daily_limit: You've hit the daily message limit. Try again tomorrow.
